title: Highland Games: Caber Toss
tagline: Toss the caber and win the day in a 3D glen
description: A small Highland Games festival: lift, run and heave the caber so it turns and lands at 12 o'clock, then put the stone and clear the bar. A lifelike athlete, real pole physics and slow-motion replays.
howToPlay: Balance the caber with the pad, then tap the button on each beat of the run.
Tap HEAVE in the green so the pole turns and lands pointing at 12 o'clock.
Put the stone and clear the bar to finish the festival.
